scope: Resolved grouping decisions only; not the complete family inventory or Item 8 acceptance

groups.name: YUNG's Better Mineshafts
groups.rationale: These are biome, material, decoration and support variants of the same specialized mineshaft network generator. All share BetterMineshaftStructure and BetterMineshaftGenerator. Their structure definitions differ only in biome constraints and BetterMineshaftConfiguration. Rooms, intersections, ore deposits, tunnels and entrance pieces are generated components, not additional families. This decision does not imply that arbitrary structures sharing a generic jigsaw codec belong to one family.

distinctions.minecraft:mineshaft: Separate vanilla generator, registered but suppressed by the frozen Better Mineshafts hook
distinctions.minecraft:mineshaft_mesa: Variant of the separate vanilla generator, registered but suppressed by the frozen Better Mineshafts hook

intended_hostility.value: Hostile rooms within an abandoned mining network
intended_hostility.basis: Derived from explicit hostile-entity spawner assignment in SideRoomDungeon and ZombieVillagerRoom, not from structure naming or measured encounter frequency.

mob_source.authored_source: Custom piece-generation code assigns ordinary block spawners to EntityType.CAVE_SPIDER and EntityType.ZOMBIE_VILLAGER.
mob_source.natural_source: The structure definitions have empty spawn_overrides. Ambient hostile populations depend on effective biome spawning and world conditions; their exact composition is UNKNOWN here.
mob_source.scope: Possible generation paths, not a claim that every mineshaft includes both rooms.

loot_table_source.basis: Direct references in the preserved generation disassemblies. SmallTunnel and BigTunnel include chest-minecart paths.
loot_table_source.effective_injections: UNKNOWN: retained loot-integration and container transformation effects still require attribution.

generated_spawners.basis: The piece code places Blocks.SPAWNER, checks SpawnerBlockEntity, then calls setEntityId.
generated_spawners.limitation: Source-supported capability; room selection, successful placement and active spawning are not established for every generated sample.

authored_or_natural_enemies.authored: Cave-spider and zombie-villager spawner assignments are authored by custom generation code.
authored_or_natural_enemies.natural: No structure-level spawn override is declared; natural spawning remains conditional on the effective biome and world state.
authored_or_natural_enemies.limitation: This does not measure enemy counts or prove a particular live spawn.

underground_surface_classification.value: Underground mining network with a VerticalEntrance generation component
underground_surface_classification.basis: Packaged step is underground_structures. BetterMineshaftStructure selects initial Y from the frozen -55 through 30 range and begins generation with VerticalEntrance.
underground_surface_classification.limitation: Initial Y is not total vertical size. The entrance envelope uses maximum build height and does not prove occupied blocks or a visible surface opening.

intended_hostility.basis: Generated spider and cave-spider spawner branches plus the packaged monster spawn override. This identifies encounter intent, not observed population or difficulty.

mob_source.scope: Spawner branches are authored generation. The piece-bounded monster override permits natural spider and cave-spider spawning subject to runtime conditions. It does not instantiate the listed groups during structure generation.

source_components.basis: Places Blocks.SPAWNER and calls SpawnerBlockEntity.setEntityId with EntityType.CAVE_SPIDER.
Alternative to the egg-room chest branch; places Blocks.SPAWNER and calls setEntityId with EntityType.SPIDER.

generated_spawners.scope: Source placement branches, not guaranteed placements or measured spawner counts. World and bounding-box conditions still apply.

loot_table_source.basis: The chest branch constructs this loot-table ResourceKey and passes it to createChest. The alternative branch creates a spider spawner.
loot_table_source.effective_injections: UNKNOWN: retained loot integrations and container transformations still require attribution.

authored_or_natural_enemies.value: Both authored spawner sources and structure-specific natural spawning rules
authored_or_natural_enemies.limitation: No claim of directly spawned mobs, observed populations or unconditional natural spawning.

underground_surface_classification.basis: Packaged step is underground_structures. The generator samples the declared absolute initial Y range 70 through 71 before constructing BigTunnel.
underground_surface_classification.limitation: Initial Y and generation step do not establish occupied vertical extent, surface exposure or discoverability.
